paragraphs: Rabbi Chanina bar Safra; [Midrash Shmuel, chapter 25](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Shmuel.25.2).

notes.text: The linked Midrash Shmuel has Chanina Safra, with no patronymic marker. In Pesachim, Rabbi Ilaa cites Rabbi Yehudah ben Safra. [Heilprin’s Yehudah entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1673&lang=en) also reads ben Safra. Hyman writes bar in both notices.
